ci._comment_collect: Start the production build (not dev server) so scores reflect what users see. `next start` on port 3002 matches Playwright + other local tooling. 3 runs per URL to damp noise; the median is what LHCI asserts against. Only public routes are audited — every admin route requires a Supabase session cookie that CI doesn't carry.

collect.startServerCommand: pnpm run build && pnpm run start -- --port 3002

ci._comment_assert: Thresholds split into two tiers: `error` for load-bearing properties (accessibility, no-broken-links, SEO basics) that a regression on is a real user-facing bug; `warn` for scores that move naturally with code size + content additions (performance, best-practices) where a minor dip per PR is acceptable but sustained decay should surface in review. Update the numbers here — never --max-warnings style overrides — when we intentionally bump what's acceptable.

upload._comment: temporary-public-storage uploads the JSON report to a free LHCI CDN with a 7-day TTL. Each PR gets a URL to the full Lighthouse report attached to the job log — no LHCI server to run. Fine for our volume; revisit if we ship an internal dashboard for perf trend lines.
